prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Choose Your Companion", "Browse and pick a ready-to-play pet to join you on your desktop right away."]
2: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Use the system tray icon to hide, feed, or talk to your pet anytime while working."]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Workspace", "We are setting up your pet's desktop rendering and animations. This will only take a moment."]
4: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress", "Use your registered account email to keep your pet settings and cloud sync active.", "Make sure to sign in with the email used when creating your pet."]
5: ["Use bright, front-facing photos in PNG or JPG format for accurate custom pet creation."]
6: ["Select Your Onboarding Experience", "Adopt a ready-made companion instantly or create your own custom pet from photos."]
7: ["Your Pet is Ready on Desktop!", "Click finish to launch your companion onto your screen."]
8: ["Verifying image facial features..."]
9: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "In less than two minutes, bring a personal virtual companion directly to your computer screen.", "Get Started"]
